module.name: Speaking Clock
module.description: Telephone speaking clocks: "At the third stroke it will be..." in the voices of the UK's TIM, Australia's Gordon Gow, and dozens of talking clocks and speech synthesisers. Each clock is a destination, and can have a number to dial. Needs app_speakingclock.so in Asterisk and its voices (https://github.com/D-Modem/speaking-clock).
module.changelog: *16.0.1* Clocks as destinations and dialable numbers, speakingclock.conf from the settings
